Supporting, closely managing, and learning from the direct customers that require unique Starlink products to meet their industry needs (i.e. primary connectivity, secondary connectivity, trucking, oil and gas, etc.)
Defining, standardizing, and streamlining processes, enabling these custom solutions to scale across the business
Delivering impeccable customer service, including efficient acknowledgment and resolution of issues

Collecting, communicating and championing customer feedback internally to influence and steer programmatic and technical development required to maintain and grow the enterprise business
Retaining and growing the value of accounts in both hardware and service revenue
Act as an extreme owner of assigned accounts to realize forecasted revenue on or ahead of schedule, identifying and successfully communicating readiness levels, requirements, schedules and risks

3+ year experience in a customer-facing role

Excellent problem-solving and sleuthing skills, going beyond just the apparent and available answer

Demonstrated ability to turn customer feedback into actionable, smart improvements
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including ability to craft and present professional presentations
Excellent empathy, active listening, and resiliency skills
Ability to read contract documents and discern requirements and deliverables

About MonetizeMore For more than 16 years, MonetizeMore has helped digital publishers grow advertising revenue, improve traffic quality, and build more sustainable monetization strategies. We work with high-traffic publishers around the world and are supported by a fully remote team of more than 100 people.

Along the way, we have earned Google certifications, industry recognition, and multiple fastest-growing company awards. We are now looking for a Senior Account Executive to help drive our next stage of growth across EMEA and APAC. The Opportunity This role is for someone who knows how to create momentum.

You will open doors with enterprise publishers, lead high-value commercial conversations, and turn complex monetization challenges into clear business opportunities.

The publishers you speak with may be facing declining revenue, invalid traffic, weak advertiser demand, operational complexity, limited performance visibility, or challenges scaling monetization across different markets and platforms.

Your job is to understand what is really holding them back, identify where MonetizeMore can create measurable value, and lead the opportunity through to close. This is a high-autonomy role. You will have ownership over your territory, pipeline, relationships, and commercial outcomes.

We will give you room to operate, but we will also expect strong judgment, disciplined execution, and consistent results. Who You Are You are a natural hunter who enjoys building opportunities rather than waiting for them.

You think commercially, move with urgency, and are comfortable leading conversations with senior decision-makers across different markets and cultures. You know how to simplify complex ideas, build trust quickly, and create a compelling reason for customers to act.

You bring: 7–10 years of experience in sales, business development, partnerships, or another commercial role. Experience from either the sell side or buy side of the digital advertising ecosystem. A track record of building pipeline and progressing complex or enterprise-level deals. Strong ownership, independence, and an entrepreneurial mindset.

The ability to connect data, insights, and customer pain to measurable business outcomes. A disciplined approach to qualification, forecasting, documentation, follow-up, and deal progression. The confidence to challenge assumptions, solve problems, and keep opportunities moving.

Familiarity with eCPM, fill rate, invalid traffic, programmatic advertising, publisher monetization, and related ad-tech concepts is a strong advantage. Experience working with mobile app publishers is highly desired, particularly in areas such as app monetization, mobile gaming, utility apps, mediation, in-app advertising, or programmatic demand.

Existing relationships with web or mobile publishers, advertisers, agencies, app developers, or ad-tech platforms will help you move faster. Experience selling publisher inventory to DV360 advertisers is valuable, but not required. Strong English communication skills are required.

Additional languages relevant to EMEA or APAC markets are a significant advantage. What You Will Own Build and manage a pipeline of enterprise web and mobile app publishers across EMEA and APAC. Create opportunities through outbound outreach, referrals, events, communities, and industry relationships.

Secure conversations with the right decision-makers and turn early interest into qualified opportunities. Lead discovery to uncover commercial, technical, and operational challenges. Build clear business cases around revenue growth, traffic protection, advertiser trust, and operational improvement.

Manage the full sales cycle from first contact through negotiation, contracting, and close. Maintain accurate forecasts, next steps, risks, and opportunity data in Salesforce. Coordinate a smooth handoff to onboarding and remain involved through implementation.

Maintain relationships after the close and identify expansion opportunities at the right time. Share market insights, competitive patterns, recurring objections, and blockers with the wider team. Represent MonetizeMore in the conversations and communities where the right publishers already operate.

What Success Looks Like You build a strong, credible pipeline and create access to publishers that fit our solutions. Your opportunities move forward with clear momentum because you understand the customer, establish urgency, and maintain structure throughout the sales process.

Publishers see you as a trusted commercial partner who understands their business, not simply as someone selling a product. Internally, your forecasts are reliable, your pipeline is clean, and your market insights help the wider team make better decisions. Video Introduction Please submit a short video covering: Who you are.

Your relevant experience. Why you believe you can succeed in this role. What you would bring to MonetizeMore ’s growth across EMEA and APAC. Benefits and Perks Work from anywhere in the world. Structure your schedule around performance and outcomes, not fixed hours. Competitive compensation aligned with your experience and impact.

High ownership over your territory, pipeline, and commercial results. The opportunity to work with major web and mobile app publishers across diverse global markets. Apply You do not need to check every box.

If you believe your experience, commercial instincts, relationships, or perspective can contribute to MonetizeMore ’s growth, we encourage you to apply. Show us how you think, what makes you stand out, and the value you can bring to the Revenue team. Originally posted on Himalayas

Unsere Mission
Wir wollen die erste Anlaufstelle für den Autowechsel werden. Mit einer Kombination aus Technologie, Medien und tiefem Verständnis für den Automobilsektor haben wir schon jetzt die Art wie Menschen Autos (ver)kaufen, vermarkten und leasen, auf den Kopf gestellt.
Was als einfache Neuwagen-Vergleichsplattform begann, ist heute einer der größten Online-Marktplätze für den Autowechsel in Europa. Im letzten Jahr allein sind wir dabei mit Fahrzeugen, die im Wert von über 5 Mrd. € über unser Portal gekauft, geleast oder versteigert wurden, um über 50% gewachsen.
2024 haben wir mit der Übernahme von Autovia – der Plattform hinter AutoExpress und dem Evo Magazin – unsere Reichweite über Nacht verdoppelt. Zusammen zählen wir nun mit fast 10 Mio. Abonnenten und 1,1 Mrd. jährlichen Aufrufen zu den größten YouTube-Kanälen der Welt. Daneben verkaufen wir 1,2 Mio. Kopien unseres Print-Magazins und erreichen jährlich über 350 Mio. Menschen mit unserem Web-Content.
Und wir sind noch lange nicht fertig.
Dein Impact @ Carwow
Mit Get Your Car Used und Sell My Car bauen wir die führende Plattform für den digitalen Fahrzeughandel auf. Unser Ziel ist es, Händler dabei zu unterstützen, Fahrzeuge effizienter zu kaufen, zu verkaufen und ihren Bestand erfolgreicher zu vermarkten.
Dafür suchen wir dich als Account Manager (m/w/d) mit Fokus auf Get Your Car Used .
Du verantwortest den Erfolg und die Weiterentwicklung unserer Händlerpartner auf der Plattform und sorgst dafür, dass sie das volle Potenzial unserer Produkte ausschöpfen.
Dabei arbeitest du eng an der Schnittstelle zwischen Carwow Used und Sell My Car und unterstützt Händler dabei, beide Plattformen erfolgreich im Tagesgeschäft zu nutzen.
Deine Aufgaben als Account Manager (m/w/d)
Du betreust und entwickelst aktiv unsere Händlerpartner auf Carwow Used und Sell My Car weiter und unterstützt sie dabei, ihre Performance auf der Plattform nachhaltig zu steigern

Dabei verstehst du die Bedürfnisse unserer Händler genau und fungierst als zentrale:r Ansprechpartner:in zwischen unseren Partnern und den internen Teams bei Carwow

Hinweis: Idealerweise bringst du (erste) Erfahrungen aus einer ähnlichen Rolle mit und hast ein Verständnis für die Automobilbranche und/oder digitale Marktplätze.

Du denkst unternehmerisch, arbeitest eigenverantwortlich und hast Spaß daran, langfristige Partnerschaften aufzubauen und weiterzuentwickeln

Über uns
Bei VREY bauen wir das EnergyOS für Mehrfamilienhäuser .
In Deutschland stehen über 3,3 Millionen Mehrparteienhäuser – und sie sind das schwarze Loch der Energiewende. <1% Solardurchdringung. <2% Smart Metering. Kaum Flexibilität oder intelligentes Energiemanagement.
Gleichzeitig zwingt die Regulierung Eigentümer zu massiven Investitionen: Solar wird zur Pflicht, Smart Meter müssen in den nächsten 5 Jahren flächendeckend ausgerollt werden, Heizung und Mobilität elektrifizieren sich. Das Mehrfamilienhaus wird vom Betongold zum aktiven Teil der dezentralen Energieinfrastruktur.
Was fehlt, ist ein integriertes System, das diesen Wandel wirtschaftlich und operativ beherrschbar macht.
VREY kombiniert zertifizierten Messstellenbetrieb mit eigener Software und ermöglicht Eigentümern erstmals, ihren selbst erzeugten Solarstrom direkt an ihre Mieter zu verkaufen – einfach und ohne selbst zum Energieversorger zu werden (§42b EnWG).
Damit wird regulatorischer Zwang zu einer profitablen und planbaren Chance:
Zweistellige Renditen und Wertsteigerung für Eigentümer,
~20 % Stromkostenersparnis für Mieter, und
digitale Infrastruktur für Speicher, Wärmepumpen und Flexibilität.
Bereits heute betreuen wir eine dreistellige Anzahl an Projekten - darunter die größten Bestandshalter und Wohnungsbaugenossenschaften - in allen 16 Bundesländern. Damit gehören wir nach kürzester Zeit zu den führenden Anbietern im Markt.
Im Zuge unserer Seed-Finanzierung haben wir 3,3 Mio. € von führenden Impact- und Energy-VCs (u. a. Rubio Impact Ventures, HTGF, Kopa Ventures) eingesammelt. Mit dem frischen Kapital gehen wir in die nächste Wachstumsphase und bauen unser Team gezielt aus.
Wir stehen am Anfang eines strukturellen Marktumbruchs. Wer heute die Energieinfrastruktur im Mehrfamilienhaus definiert, prägt sie für Jahrzehnte. Werde Teil von VREY und baue mit uns das führende EnergyOS.

Du hast bereits erste Erfahrungen im Consulting (Tier 1/Tier 2) , High-Growth Start-ups (idealerweise Business Development, Partnerships oder Sales), oder im VC-Umfeld gesammelt
Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation in einem relevanten Bereich (z. B. Betriebswirtschaft, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Energiewirtschaft, Entrepreneurship oder einem verwandten Feld)

Dein Ziel: Strukturen, Prozesse und Initiativen zu entwickeln, die es uns ermöglichen, die Energiewende in Mehrfamilienhäusern deutschlandweit schnell und skalierbar umzusetzen. Every 10 minutes, 18 million conversations happen between businesses and consumers around the world.
For decades, the consumer side of those conversations sucked: long queues, robotic menus, repeated explanations, and advice that is often unhelpful. Most people today still cannot simply say what their problem is in natural language when communicating with businesses.
AI changes that. For the first time, companies can have natural conversations with customers at massive scale. Every B2C company - from energy providers to telcos to insurers - will use AI agents to talk to their customers. The number of conversations businesses will handle is going to explode in the coming years.
At telli, we are solving the challenges that come with that shift. Today, leading B2C companies like Sky are already using telli to deploy thousands of voice agents to provide their customers with a new experience.

But building a first voice agent is easy, getting it to drive real outcomes for customers and businesses is the hard part. telli helps companies build, deploy, and improve consumer-facing AI voice agents at scale. This will become one of the most important software categories of the next decade, and we intend to win it.
We are a small, AI-pilled team that likes to solve hard problems. Be it engineering, product, or GTM - we build, experiment, and move fast, while heavily leveraging the capabilities of AI models. All of us like to challenge ourselves and take real ownership over what we do, all while still staying humble and keeping a low-ego culture.
Check out our principles to see how we work.

s.h: Who We're Looking For: Digital Marketing Account Manager: REMOTE
s.t:
We’re looking for a high-impact, client-facing Account Manager to serve as the dedicated advocate and primary point of contact for a portfolio of C-4 Analytics ' key clients.

This isn’t a passive coordination role; it’s a proactive, holistic management position where you take full ownership of translating complex business objectives into winning digital marketing programs.

You’ll be expected to master our core services and articulate their value with authority, acting as the strategic bridge between client goals and technical execution.
You’ll operate at the center of the action, driving comprehensive strategies and managing high-stakes campaign tasks across every internal department—from Paid Search and Creative to Content, Local, and Social Media. This role requires a "do-the-work" mentality to ensure every moving part is synchronized and every campaign is delivered with precision. If you’re a natural relationship-builder who thrives on connecting the dots between client vision and digital performance, you’ll do well here.
A day in the life of a Digital Marketing Account Manager: REMOTE
Portfolio & Relationship Management: Serve as the primary advocate and day-to-day contact for a portfolio of 12+ "rooftops," proactively managing client satisfaction and performance to ensure maximum retention.
Strategic Execution & Optimization: Own the full campaign lifecycle—from initial strategy and pitch to setup and execution—across Paid Search, Social, and Web, while conducting regular platform checks to ensure optimal performance.
Data Analysis & Reporting: Utilize Google Analytics and Google Ads to analyze traffic, pitch optimizations, and deliver comprehensive monthly reports that translate complex data into compelling narratives.
Cross-Functional & Third-Party Coordination: Lead internal teams (Creative, Content, Paid Search) and external vendors to ensure timely implementation of strategies and rigorous task tracking within JIRA.
Communication & Presentation: Lead weekly client update meetings and maintain professional, timely communication to keep stakeholders informed on progress and campaign health.
Compliance & Quality Control: Ensure all marketing assets meet brand standards, maintain regulatory compliance, and receive formal client approval prior to launch.
Operational Agility: Handle additional duties as assigned and travel as necessary to support client needs and business objectives.

Bachelor's Degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, a related degree or equivalent relevant industry experience

A positive attitude that resonates throughout your team and the company

ExtraHop is reinventing Network Detection and Response (NDR) to offer enterprises unparalleled visibility, context, and control against emerging threats. By decrypting and analyzing complete packet-level data at wire speed and leveraging cloud-scale machine learning, ExtraHop empowers Security Operations Centers (SOCs) to detect, investigate, and remediate modern cyber risks in real time across their entire hybrid infrastructure, including data center, cloud, and SASE environments.
This comprehensive approach and market innovation have earned ExtraHop unique recognition as the only NDR vendor acknowledged as a leader by all major analyst firms, including the 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant for Network Detection and Response™, the 2025 Forrester® Wave for Network Analysis and Visibility, the 2024 IDC® Marketscape for NDR, and the 2025 Gigamon® Radar Report for Network Detection and Response.

Since 2007, ExtraHop has consistently helped organizations worldwide extract in-depth network telemetry and contextual insights, affirming its commitment to protecting and empowering the connected enterprise.

s.h: We’re looking for a Business Development Executive
s.t: This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced outbound sales professional to join our direct sales team to qualify and convert leads in a fast paced and fun environment. You'll benefit from an uncapped commission structure , giving you full control over your earnings. OTE of £78k-£83k, with even higher earning potential available through promotion.

As a Business Development Executive you’ll build a high quality pipeline of prospects and generate revenue by making outbound calls, booking meetings, following up with customers, using Social Selling tools, and much more. Each interaction with a potential new customer is unique, and requires focus as well as solo thinking.

How you manage your pipeline will make a significant difference in hitting your KPIs. If you are successful, the opportunity to grow and develop as a sales professional is unbounded.

Using Social Selling tools & techniques to maximise your success in connecting with prospects
Identifying and qualifying prospects that might have a need for business finance
Communicating the iwoca value proposition in a precise and compelling way to engage and convert prospects
Going above and beyond in your efforts to hit and exceed your KPIs; this will enable us to beat sales growth targets
Working as a team player, and helping improve the overall success of this exciting part of the business.
We look for people who are smart, humble, motivated and who are always looking to improve.

Be comfortable making cold outbound calls, and have an outstanding call manner
Be highly motivated, and excited to exceed targets
Be able to take on, and provide, quality feedback to power your own growth, as well as that of your teammates
Be organised and able to manage a large pipeline of prospects, with deals at various stages of progress
Be able to simplify and explain complex products in a way that customers with little experience in commercial financing can easily understand

Understand the challenges facing small businesses

Don’t take this list as prescriptive: it’s just to give you a sense of who might do well at the job. We’d still love to hear from you if you don’t hit every point on the list, or if you have other experience.

At iwoca , we prioritise a culture of learning, growth, and support, and invest in the development of our team members. Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?
Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence.

SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world.

Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.

Reporting to the Director, Business Development, the Sr. Business Development Manager will play a key role in driving strategic partnerships and leading the commercial structuring, negotiation and execution of commercial arrangements across Studio Business Group (SBG).

SBG supports PlayStation Studios’ first-party business, working across studios and teams to enable the development and delivery of world-class gaming experiences.

Working within the broader business development strategy, this role will lead deals from initial evaluation and commercial structuring through negotiation, contracting, internal approvals and execution. The Sr.

Business Development Manager will work closely with Legal, Finance and business stakeholders to evaluate deal economics, develop commercial terms, navigate contractual and IP considerations, and drive deals toward successful completion.
The successful candidate will be an experienced and confident deal leader who combines strong commercial judgement with disciplined execution. They will be comfortable independently leading complex negotiations with external partners, while recognizing when strategic, financial or risk considerations require alignment or escalation to the Director and other senior stakeholders.
This role is located in the UK and you will operate as part of a global team, with primary responsibility for commercial matters in Europe and support for matters in other regions as business needs require.

Deal Management & Negotiation
Lead and manage commercial negotiations and strategic deals from initial opportunity assessment through execution.
Develop negotiation approaches and commercial structures aligned with established business and commercial objectives.
Evaluate deal economics, key value drivers, financial implications and trade-offs to support recommendations and decision-making.
Negotiate with external partners and identify practical solutions that balance commercial opportunity with appropriate management of risk.
Partner with senior business development and business leaders on particularly complex, high-value or strategically significant transactions.
Commercial Structuring & Contracting
Develop and negotiate commercial terms across a range of arrangements, including partnerships, licensing and other strategic commercial arrangements.
Partner closely with Legal, Finance and relevant business teams to evaluate contractual, licensing, intellectual property and financial considerations.
Translate business requirements and negotiated positions into clear commercial terms.
Identify commercial, contractual and operational risks and work with appropriate stakeholders to develop solutions or escalation paths.
End-to-End Deal Execution
Support the commercial management of agreements throughout their lifecycle, including amendments, renewals, extensions, commercial issues and exits, working with Legal and relevant business owners as appropriate.
Manage the deal process from initial evaluation and negotiation through contracting, approvals, execution and handoff.
Coordinate cross-functional stakeholders throughout the deal lifecycle to maintain alignment and drive timely decision-making.
Develop business cases, deal recommendations and materials to support internal reviews and approvals.
Maintain clear documentation of commercial positions, approvals, commitments and key decisions.
Contribute to the continued development of deal-management processes, tools and governance.
Stakeholder & Partner Management
Build strong relationships with internal stakeholders and serve as a knowledgeable commercial partner throughout the deal process.
Act as a trusted commercial partner to business leaders and cross-functional stakeholders, providing advice on deal structures, commercial terms, negotiation strategy, rights and obligations, and commercial risk.
Develop and maintain trusted relationships with external partners.
Navigate differing priorities across internal teams and external partners to build alignment and move negotiations forward.
Support ongoing partner relationships and identify opportunities to strengthen or expand commercial partnerships.

8+ years of experience in business development, deal management, commercial strategy, partnerships or a related field, with a demonstrated track record of independently leading complex commercial negotiations.
A bachelor’s degree (or equivalent qualification or relevant professional experience) in Business, Law, Finance, or a related field.
Demonstrated experience structuring, negotiating and executing commercial arrangements, ideally within gaming, entertainment, media, tech or other IP-led industries.
Strong commercial acumen with the ability to assess deal economics, value drivers, financial trade-offs and business implications.
Working knowledge of commercial contracts, licensing and intellectual property considerations, with experience partnering closely with Legal.
Experience managing deals across the full lifecycle, including negotiation, contracting, approvals and execution.
Strong stakeholder-management skills and experience working across complex, cross-functional organizations.
Ability to build credible and productive relationships with external partners.
Sound judgement and the ability to balance commercial opportunity with legal, financial and operational considerations.
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple deals and priorities simultaneously.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to clearly communicate commercial issues, trade-offs and recommendations.
High standards of professionalism and integrity.
